subject: Quick check: end-of-quarter timing and approval for inference pilot
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Mar 2025 15:24:00 +0000
Subject: Quick check: end-of-quarter timing and approval for inference pilot

Hi Maria — great speaking earlier today. Thanks for walking through Acme's goals and the two high-priority proof points (search relevance re-rank and session-based assistant latency). Short recap + suggested next steps so we stay aligned with your Q2 kick-off planning:

What we heard:
- Pilot scope: re-rank for search (100k queries/day sample) + assistant endpoint for customer support routing.
- Success metrics: +8-10 pts NDCG on re-rank evals; 90th percentile latency <200ms for assistant flows.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required; data residency in us-east.

Next steps we proposed on the call:
1) Redwood delivers a one-page mutual action plan (attached) and a pilot SOW draft (attached SLA-Draft.pdf) by EOD Friday.
2) You confirm decision owners and the procurement timeline so we can align internal resources.
3) Quick technical kickoff (30m) with your infra lead next week to validate VPC/firewall access.

Open question (to help timing): is the approval budgeted in this quarter's forecast, or would it need a next-quarter approval cycle? If the former, we can target a mid-April pilot start; if the latter, we should shift expectations.

Attachments: MAP_Proposal_Acme_030725.pdf (proposal + mutual action plan), Redwood_Pilot_OnePager.pdf (scoped pilot overview), SLA-Draft.pdf (service-level and timeline draft).

If it helps, I've also dropped the HubSpot deal and the MAP into the shared Drive link below. Happy to jump on a short call to walk procurement through the SOW if that speeds approvals.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-8901
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

Thanks — talk soon.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Maria — bumping this as Q1 wraps up today and wanted to check whether priorities/budgeting shifted on your side. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you confirm whether the pilot budget is included in this quarter's approvals (so we can aim for a mid-April start)?
2) If approvals are delayed, would it help for us to run a scoped technical spike (no-cost, 1-week) to validate latency and infra assumptions so procurement has concrete numbers?

If it’s easier, I can introduce Lauren (cc'd) to your procurement contact for a short 20-minute walkthrough. No pressure — we just want to avoid missing your internal planning window if things have changed.

Thanks for a quick ping back when you have a moment.

Hi Marcus — thanks for the follow-up and for the clear MAP. Short answer: we are still interested and the pilot is on track, but final approvals slipped past our internal Q1 review. Procurement is reviewing the SOW this week and expects sign-off by ~Apr 10.

A couple notes: 
- Budget: approved, but routing/PO issuance is delayed behind a vendor consolidation review.
- Compliance: procurement asked for the SOC2 attestation (can you share the latest report or a link?).

Yes, please introduce Lauren to procurement — a short walkthrough of the billing model and SLA terms would be helpful. If you can share the SOC2 link and a one-page security checklist, I'll forward to the team and we should be able to close the loop next week.

Thanks — Maria
